template.name: fast
template.description: fast(p, n) [time] Method: p.fast(...). Play p n times faster (n times per bar).

template.name: slow
template.description: slow(p, n) [time] Method: p.slow(...). Stretch p over n bars.

template.name: late
template.description: late(p, t) [time] Method: p.late(...). Delay p by t bars: in 4/4, 1/8 is an eighth note.

template.name: early
template.description: early(p, t) [time] Method: p.early(...). Shift p earlier by t bars.

template.name: rev
template.description: rev(p) [time] Method: p.rev. Reverse p within each bar. On a list, reverses the list.

template.name: every
template.description: every(p, n, f, at: n-1) [time] Method: p.every(...). Apply f on one bar out of every n (the last one by default, where fills belong).

template.name: palindrome
template.description: palindrome(p) [time] Method: p.palindrome. Play p forwards, then backwards, alternating bars.

template.name: iter
template.description: iter(p, n) [time] Method: p.iter(...). Rotate the start of p by 1/n each bar.

template.name: off
template.description: off(p, t, f) [time] Method: p.off(...). Layer p with a copy shifted by t bars and transformed by f.

template.name: echo
template.description: echo(p, times: 3, time: 1/8, decay: 0.6) [time] Method: p.echo. Repeat each event, quieter each time.

template.name: ply
template.description: ply(p, n) [time] Method: p.ply(...). Repeat each event n times within its own length. n may be a pattern.

template.name: swing
template.description: swing(p, amount: 1/3, div: 8) [time] Method: p.swing. Delay every second subdivision (eighths by default) by a fraction of a step. 1/3 gives triplet swing (long-short 2:1), 0.2 a lighter 3:2, 0 is straight.

template.name: humanize
template.description: humanize(p, time: 0.004, vel: 0.1) [chance] Method: p.humanize. Seeded random drift in timing (bars) and velocity. Replayable like all randomness.

template.name: stack
template.description: stack(a, b, ...) [time] Play patterns at the same time.

template.name: cat
template.description: cat(a, b, ...) [time] One pattern per bar, in turn.

template.name: seq
template.description: seq(a, b, ...) [time] Squeeze patterns one after another into a single bar.

template.name: arrange
template.description: arrange(p1, bars1, p2, bars2, ...) [time] Chain patterns, each lasting the given number of bars, and loop the whole.

template.name: poly
template.description: poly(p, steps) [time] Method: p.poly(...). Polymeter: step through p's elements at `steps` per bar, whatever its length.

template.name: euclid
template.description: euclid(p, hits, steps, rot: 0) [time] Method: p.euclid(...). Spread `hits` events as evenly as possible over `steps` (Euclidean rhythm).

template.name: trunc
template.description: trunc(p, fraction) [time] Method: p.trunc(...). Play only the first fraction of each bar.

template.name: per_bar
template.description: per_bar(bar => pattern) [time] Build each bar from a function of the bar number. Randomness inside is keyed to the bar.

template.name: evolve
template.description: evolve(start, (state, bar) => next, (state, bar) => pattern) [time] Carry state from bar to bar. Bar 0 plays view(start); each later bar's state is step(previous state, bar). Replayable: states are always computed forward from bar 0.

template.name: loop
template.description: loop(p, bars) [time] Method: p.loop(...). Repeat the first `bars` bars of p forever.

template.name: degrade
template.description: degrade(p, amount: 0.5) [chance] Method: p.degrade. Randomly drop events (seeded).

template.name: sometimes
template.description: sometimes(p, prob, f) [chance] Method: p.sometimes(...). Apply f to each event with the given probability (seeded).

template.name: often
template.description: often(p, f) [chance] Method: p.often(...). Apply f to about 75% of events.

template.name: rarely
template.description: rarely(p, f) [chance] Method: p.rarely(...). Apply f to about 25% of events.

template.name: maybe
template.description: maybe(p, prob, f) [chance] Method: p.maybe(...). Apply f to whole bars with the given probability (seeded).

template.name: dice
template.description: dice(list, steps: 1) [chance] A new seeded random pick from list on each of `steps` steps per bar.

template.name: walk
template.description: walk(list, steps: 8, stride: 1) [chance] A seeded random walk through list: each step moves at most `stride` places.

template.name: scramble
template.description: scramble(p) [chance] Method: p.scramble. Shuffle the elements of a phrase into a new seeded order each bar.

template.name: rand
template.description: rand() [chance] A seeded random number in [0, 1). Same seed, same number.

template.name: rand_int
template.description: rand_int(lo, hi) [chance] A seeded random whole number from lo to hi inclusive.

template.name: pick
template.description: pick(list) [chance] One seeded random element of list.

template.name: weighted
template.description: weighted(list, weights) [chance] A seeded random element, chosen in proportion to weights.

template.name: shuffle
template.description: shuffle(list) [chance] The list in a seeded random order (decided once).

template.name: chance
template.description: chance(prob) [chance] true with the given probability (seeded).

template.name: transpose
template.description: transpose(p, semitones) [pitch] Method: p.transpose(...). Move by semitones (fractions allowed: 0.5 is a quarter tone). Works on notes, degrees, chords and patterns.

template.name: octave
template.description: octave(p, n) [pitch] Method: p.octave(...). Move by n octaves (of the scale's period for degrees).

template.name: step
template.description: step(p, n) [pitch] Method: p.step(...). Move by n steps of the current scale (diatonic transposition).

template.name: degrees
template.description: degrees(p) [pitch] Method: p.degrees. Treat numbers as 0-based scale steps: [0 2 4].degrees is [^1 ^3 ^5].

template.name: key
template.description: key(root, scale) or p.key(root, scale) [pitch] Make a key, or play p in a key. Degrees like ^3 resolve against it.

template.name: chord
template.description: chord(root, quality) [pitch] A chord: chord(c4, "maj7") is the same as c4@maj7. With one text argument it reads a chord symbol: chord("Bb7#11").

template.name: invert
template.description: invert(p, n: 1) [pitch] Method: p.invert. Chord inversion: move the lowest n notes up an octave.

template.name: arp
template.description: arp(p, mode: "up") [pitch] Method: p.arp. Spread each chord's notes across its length. Modes: up, down, updown, downup, out, random.

template.name: strum
template.description: strum(p, spread: 1/48) [pitch] Method: p.strum. Roll each chord's notes, low to high, `spread` bars apart.

template.name: hz
template.description: hz(pitch) [pitch] Frequency of a pitch in Hz (at the current tuning).

template.name: note_num
template.description: note_num(pitch) [pitch] The (possibly fractional) MIDI note number of a pitch.

template.name: pitch
template.description: pitch(n) [pitch] A pitch from a MIDI note number (fractions allowed).

template.name: ratio
template.description: ratio(r) [pitch] The size of a frequency ratio in semitones: ratio(3/2) is about 7.02.

template.name: scale
template.description: scale(semitones, period: 12) [pitch] A scale from semitone offsets (fractions allowed).

template.name: just
template.description: just(ratios, period: 2) [pitch] A just-intonation scale from frequency ratios, e.g. just([1 9/8 5/4 3/2 5/3]).

template.name: edo
template.description: edo(n, steps) [pitch] An n-tone equal division of the octave. With steps, a scale picked from it: edo(31, [0 5 10 13 18 23 28]).

template.name: cents
template.description: cents(list, period: 1200) [pitch] A scale from offsets in cents.

template.name: scala
template.description: scala(text) [pitch] A scale from the text of a Scala .scl file (the common microtonal tuning format).

template.name: scala_file
template.description: scala_file(path) [pitch] A scale loaded from a Scala .scl file next to your piece.

template.name: mode
template.description: mode(scale, n) [pitch] Rotate a scale to start on its n-th degree (1-based): mode(major, 2) is dorian.

template.name: vel
template.description: vel(p, v) [sound] Method: p.vel(...). Velocity 0 to 1. v may itself be a pattern: .vel([1 .5 .7 .5]).

template.name: legato
template.description: legato(p, x) [sound] Method: p.legato(...). Note length as a fraction of its step (1 = full, 0.5 = staccato).

template.name: gain
template.description: gain(p, x) [sound] Method: p.gain(...). Output level multiplier for the built-in synth.

template.name: pan
template.description: pan(p, x) [sound] Method: p.pan(...). Stereo position from -1 (left) to 1 (right).

template.name: cutoff
template.description: cutoff(p, hz) [sound] Method: p.cutoff(...). Filter cutoff for the built-in synth.

template.name: res
template.description: res(p, x) [sound] Method: p.res(...). Filter resonance 0 to 1.

template.name: attack
template.description: attack(p, seconds) [sound] Method: p.attack(...). Envelope attack time.

template.name: release
template.description: release(p, seconds) [sound] Method: p.release(...). Envelope release time.

template.name: decay
template.description: decay(p, seconds) [sound] Method: p.decay(...). Envelope decay time.

template.name: sustain
template.description: sustain(p, level) [sound] Method: p.sustain(...). Envelope sustain level 0 to 1.

template.name: reverb
template.description: reverb(p, amount) [sound] Method: p.reverb(...). Send to the built-in reverb, 0 to 1.

template.name: hpf
template.description: hpf(p, hz) [sound] Method: p.hpf(...). High-pass filter on the whole voice: removes rumble below hz. Unlike cutoff, which shapes each note, this filters the voice's mix.

template.name: lpf
template.description: lpf(p, hz) [sound] Method: p.lpf(...). Low-pass filter on the whole voice: darkens everything above hz. Try .lpf(sine(8).range(400, 3400)) for a sweep.

template.name: drive
template.description: drive(p, amount) [sound] Method: p.drive(...). Saturation on the whole voice, 0 (clean) to 1 (crushed). Chords distort together, like an amp.

template.name: delay
template.description: delay(p, mix, time: 3/16, feedback: .4) [sound] Method: p.delay(...). An echo on the whole voice. mix 0 to 1; time in bars (3/16 is a dotted eighth in 4/4); feedback 0 to .95 sets how many repeats.

template.name: wave
template.description: wave(p, name) [sound] Method: p.wave(...). Oscillator of the synth instrument (and its presets): saw, square, pulse, tri, sine, super, fm or noise.

template.name: pw
template.description: pw(p, width) [sound] Method: p.pw(...). Pulse width of the pulse wave, 0 to 1 (.5 is square). May be a pattern or a signal.

template.name: detune
template.description: detune(p, cents) [sound] Method: p.detune(...). Spread of the unison voices, in cents either side.

template.name: unison
template.description: unison(p, n) [sound] Method: p.unison(...). How many detuned oscillators sound together (1 to 16).

template.name: sub
template.description: sub(p, level) [sound] Method: p.sub(...). A sine one octave below, 0 to 1.

template.name: glide
template.description: glide(p, seconds) [sound] Method: p.glide(...). Slide into each note from the one before it in the voice.

template.name: fenv
template.description: fenv(p, octaves, attack: .001, decay: .2) [sound] Method: p.fenv(...). Filter envelope: the cutoff jumps up by this many octaves and falls back over decay seconds. The acid squelch.

template.name: fm
template.description: fm(p, index, ratio: 2, decay: .4) [sound] Method: p.fm(...). Frequency modulation (switches the synth to the fm wave): index is brightness, ratio the modulator's pitch, decay how fast the brightness fades. Also an instrument: Two-operator FM: a sine modulated by a sine. .fm(index, ratio, decay) sets the colour.

template.name: vibrato
template.description: vibrato(p, rate: 5, depth: .3) [sound] Method: p.vibrato. Pitch wobble, rate in Hz, depth in semitones.

template.name: wobble
template.description: wobble(p, rate: 2, depth: 2) [sound] Method: p.wobble. Filter wobble in time with the music: rate in cycles per bar, depth in octaves. Also an instrument: Saw and sub through a filter that wobbles in time: .wobble(rate per bar, depth).

template.name: vowel
template.description: vowel(p, v) [sound] Method: p.vowel(...). Formant filter: makes the voice say a vowel, "a" "e" "i" "o" or "u". v may be a pattern: .vowel(["a" "o"]).

template.name: crush
template.description: crush(p, bits) [sound] Method: p.crush(...). Bit crusher: fewer bits (1 to 16) is rougher. .crush(4) is very lo-fi.

template.name: coarse
template.description: coarse(p, n) [sound] Method: p.coarse(...). Sample-rate reduction: holds every nth sample, for aliasing and grit. 1 is off.

template.name: ring
template.description: ring(p, hz, mix: 1) [sound] Method: p.ring(...). Ring modulation: multiplies the voice by a sine at hz, for metallic and bell-like tones.

template.name: chorus
template.description: chorus(p, mix: .5, rate: .8, depth: .5) [sound] Method: p.chorus. Chorus: thickens the voice with slightly detuned, moving copies. rate in Hz.

template.name: phaser
template.description: phaser(p, mix: .5, rate: .5, depth: .7) [sound] Method: p.phaser. Phaser: a sweeping notch, the classic swirl. rate in Hz.

template.name: compress
template.description: compress(p, threshold: -18, ratio: 4) [sound] Method: p.compress. Compressor on the whole voice: levels above threshold (dB) are reduced by ratio, then made up. Evens out a part.

template.name: room
template.description: room(p, mix: .3, size: .5) [sound] Method: p.room. A reverb on this voice alone, unlike reverb(), which sends to the shared room. size 0 to 1.

template.name: duck
template.description: duck(p, voice, depth: .8, release: 1/8) [sound] Method: p.duck(...). Sidechain-style ducking: this voice dips each time the named voice plays a note, then recovers over release bars. .duck("kick") pumps a pad against the kick.

template.name: dur
template.description: dur(p, beats) [sound] Method: p.dur(...). Fixed note length in beats, independent of the step length.

template.name: set
template.description: set(p, name, value) [sound] Method: p.set(...). Attach any named parameter to events (it is passed through to MIDI CC maps and exports).

template.name: inst
template.description: inst(p, name, ...options) [sound] Method: p.inst(...). Choose a built-in instrument: keys, sine, tri, saw, square, pluck, bass, pad, bell, organ, kit, or a loaded sample name.

template.name: sample
template.description: sample(p, name, n: 0, fit: false) [sound] Method: p.sample(...). Play a sound from the sample library: a full name ("bd_haus"), a bank ("bd", with n choosing among its sounds), or "bank:n". On a drum phrase with no name it plays the bundled kit. name and n may be patterns. With fit: true the sound is stretched to the note's length.

template.name: begin
template.description: begin(p, x) [sound] Method: p.begin(...). Start playing a sample from this point, 0 (its start) to 1 (its end).

template.name: end
template.description: end(p, x) [sound] Method: p.end(...). Stop playing a sample at this point, 0 to 1.

template.name: speed
template.description: speed(p, x) [sound] Method: p.speed(...). Sample playback rate: 2 is an octave up and twice as fast, -1 plays it backwards.

template.name: accel
template.description: accel(p, x) [sound] Method: p.accel(...). Change a sample's speed by x every second while it plays: speed(1).accel(-1) is a tape stop.

template.name: cut
template.description: cut(p, group) [sound] Method: p.cut(...). Cut group: a sample in this group stops the one before it, in any voice. Choke an open hat with a closed one.

template.name: loopAt
template.description: loopAt(p, bars) [sound] Method: p.loopAt(...). Make a sample last this many bars, whatever the tempo: the phrase is slowed to that length and the sample stretched to fit. Add chop to keep a long loop in time: ["loop_amen"].loopAt(2).chop(16).

template.name: slice
template.description: slice(p, n, i) [sound] Method: p.slice(...). Cut the sample into n equal pieces and play piece i (from 0). i may be a pattern: .slice(8, [0 3 2 7]).

template.name: splice
template.description: splice(p, n, i) [sound] Method: p.splice(...). Like slice, but each piece is stretched to fill its note, so a sliced loop stays in tempo.

template.name: chop
template.description: chop(p, n) [sound] Method: p.chop(...). Split each note into n notes that play successive parts of its sample. With loopAt, a loop follows the tempo: loop_amen.loopAt(2).chop(16).

template.name: soundfont
template.description: soundfont(source) [input] Load a SoundFont 2 (.sf2) bank, as a top-level line: a file next to the piece, a URL, or "github:user/repo/path.sf2". Then play its instruments with .gm(). General MIDI banks such as GeneralUser GS give all 128 standard instruments and the drum kits.

template.name: gm
template.description: gm(p, program, bank: 0) [sound] Method: p.gm(...). Play notes on an instrument of the loaded SoundFont: a General MIDI program number from 1 (piano) to 128, or a name to search for, .gm("violin"). On drum names with no program it plays the drum kit.

template.name: samples
template.description: samples(source) [input] Load a sample pack, as a top-level line: a folder (command line), a URL of a strudel.json sample map, or "github:user/repo" for that repository's strudel.json. Sounds load on first use.

template.name: dirt
template.description: dirt(p, sound: "", orbit: 0) [sound] Method: p.dirt. Send to SuperDirt (TidalCycles' sound engine) instead of the built-in sound, over OSC from tine daw or tine dirt. sound is a SuperDirt sample bank or synth; without it, sample names, drum names and instruments are translated.

template.name: midi
template.description: midi(p, channel: 1, port: "") [sound] Method: p.midi. Send to an external MIDI device instead of the built-in synth.

template.name: ctl
template.description: ctl(p, number, value) [sound] Method: p.ctl(...). Send a MIDI control change (value 0 to 1) just before each note. value may be a pattern or signal: .ctl(74, sine(4)).

template.name: program
template.description: program(p, n) [sound] Method: p.program(...). Choose an instrument on external gear with a MIDI program change (1 to 128, as printed in General MIDI lists). It is sent only when it changes.

template.name: as_cc
template.description: as_cc(p, number, rate: 16) [sound] Method: p.as_cc(...). Turn a voice of numbers (0 to 1) into MIDI control changes instead of notes: voice sweep = sine(4).as_cc(74).midi(1). A signal is sampled `rate` times per bar.

template.name: mpe
template.description: mpe(p) [sound] Method: p.mpe. Send each note on its own MIDI channel (2 to 16) so microtonal pitch bends do not collide.

template.name: cc
template.description: cc(number, channel: any) [input] A live signal (0 to 1) from a MIDI controller knob or fader.

template.name: held
template.description: held(steps: 1) [input] The notes currently held on your MIDI keyboard, as a chord, sampled `steps` times per bar. Try held(4).arp.

template.name: sine
template.description: sine(period: 1) [generators] A smooth signal from 0 to 1 and back, once per `period` bars. Also an instrument: Pure sine wave.

template.name: tri
template.description: tri(period: 1) [generators] A triangle signal, 0 up to 1 and back. Also an instrument: Triangle wave, soft and hollow.

template.name: saw
template.description: saw(period: 1) [generators] A ramp from 0 to 1 every `period` bars. Also an instrument: Sawtooth through a low-pass filter, bright.

template.name: square
template.description: square(period: 1) [generators] Alternates between 0 and 1. Also an instrument: Square wave, reedy.

template.name: noise
template.description: noise(rate: 16) [generators] A seeded random signal holding a new value `rate` times per bar. Also an instrument: Filtered white noise, for risers, sweeps and hats.

template.name: drift
template.description: drift(rate: 1) [generators] A smooth seeded random signal, wandering between 0 and 1.

template.name: range
template.description: range(signal, lo, hi) [generators] Rescale a 0..1 signal or pattern to lo..hi.

template.name: seg
template.description: seg(signal, n) [generators] Sample a signal n times per bar, turning it into discrete events.

template.name: run
template.description: run(n) [generators] The phrase [0 1 2 ... n-1].

template.name: len
template.description: len(list) [lists] Number of elements.

template.name: at
template.description: at(list, i) [lists] Element i (0-based; wraps around, so negative counts from the end).

template.name: map
template.description: map(p, f) [lists] Method: p.map(...). Apply f to every element of a list, or every event of a pattern.

template.name: filter
template.description: filter(list, f) [lists] Keep elements (or events) for which f is true.

template.name: fold
template.description: fold(list, start, f) [lists] Combine elements left to right: fold([1 2 3], 0, (a, x) => a + x).

template.name: concat
template.description: concat(a, b, ...) [lists] Join lists into one longer list (one bar, more steps).

template.name: repeat
template.description: repeat(x, n) [lists] A list of n copies of x.

template.name: take
template.description: take(list, n) [lists] The first n elements.

template.name: drop
template.description: drop(list, n) [lists] All but the first n elements.

template.name: rotate
template.description: rotate(list, n) [lists] Rotate a list left by n places.

template.name: sum
template.description: sum(list) [lists] Add up the elements.

template.name: floor
template.description: floor(x) [math] Round down.

template.name: ceil
template.description: ceil(x) [math] Round up.

template.name: round
template.description: round(x) [math] Round to nearest.

template.name: abs
template.description: abs(x) [math] Absolute value.

template.name: sqrt
template.description: sqrt(x) [math] Square root.

template.name: sin
template.description: sin(x) [math] Sine (radians).

template.name: cos
template.description: cos(x) [math] Cosine (radians).

template.name: log2
template.description: log2(x) [math] Base-2 logarithm.

template.name: exp
template.description: exp(x) [math] e to the power x.

template.name: min
template.description: min(a, b, ...) [math] Smallest value.

template.name: max
template.description: max(a, b, ...) [math] Largest value.

template.name: clamp
template.description: clamp(x, lo, hi) [math] Limit x to the range lo..hi.

template.name: lerp
template.description: lerp(a, b, t) [math] Linear blend from a to b.

template.name: print
template.description: print(x, ...) [misc] Show values in the console.

template.name: str
template.description: str(x) [misc] Text form of a value.

template.name: type
template.description: type(x) [misc] The name of a value's type.

template.name: changes
template.description: changes(text, octave: 3) [harmony] Chords from a lead sheet: changes("Dm7 G7 | Cmaj7 %"). Bars are split by |, chords in a bar share it, / holds a chord one more slot, % repeats the bar, N.C. is no chord. Loops over its bars.

template.name: root
template.description: root(p) [harmony] Method: p.root. The root of each chord (from its symbol, or named from its notes). Single notes pass through. Try changes(...).root.octave(-1) for a bass line.

template.name: bassnote
template.description: bassnote(p) [harmony] Method: p.bassnote. The bass note of each chord: the slash note of c@7/e, otherwise the root.

template.name: within
template.description: within(p, lo, hi: lo + 12) [pitch] Method: p.within(...). Move each note or chord by whole octaves until it sits in lo..hi (a chord moves by its lowest note and keeps its shape). changes(...).bassnote.within(e1, e2) folds a bass line into one octave.

template.name: tones
template.description: tones(chord) [harmony] A chord's notes as a list, low to high.

template.name: name
template.description: name(x, bars: 1) [harmony] Name a chord, or the chords of a pattern, as a chord symbol: name({e g c5}) is "C/E".

template.name: shell
template.description: shell(p) [harmony] Method: p.shell. Shell voicings: root, third and seventh, the bebop pianist's left hand.

template.name: guide
template.description: guide(p) [harmony] Method: p.guide. Guide tones: just the third and seventh of each chord. Add .voicelead to hear them move by step.

template.name: rootless
template.description: rootless(p, form: "a") [harmony] Method: p.rootless. Rootless voicings: four notes without the root (3-5-7-9, dominants use the 13th for the 5th). Form "a" starts on the third, "b" on the seventh.

template.name: drop2
template.description: drop2(p) [harmony] Method: p.drop2. Drop-2 voicings: close position, with the second voice from the top dropped an octave.

template.name: drop3
template.description: drop3(p) [harmony] Method: p.drop3. Drop-3 voicings: close position, with the third voice from the top dropped an octave.

template.name: drop24
template.description: drop24(p) [harmony] Method: p.drop24. Drop-2-and-4 voicings: the second and fourth voices from the top dropped an octave.

template.name: voicelead
template.description: voicelead(p, around: e4) [harmony] Method: p.voicelead. Voice leading: play each chord in the close-position inversion that moves least from the previous chord, staying near `around`. Deterministic: built on evolve, so the chain is replayed from bar 0.

template.name: interval
template.description: interval(a, b, long: false) [harmony] The interval between two pitches by size: interval(c4, e4) is "M3"; with long: true, "major 3rd". Tine counts semitones, so C-F# and C-Gb are both TT (tritone).
